rules.rule: The generic event check-in entry (CheckinService::scan) must refuse any person with a child_profiles row and require the ChildrenService/ChildParticipationSafetyGate boundary; that boundary is the sole authority admitting a protected participant, revalidating CHILDREN permission, guardian delivery authorization and unrevoked participation consent under the child_profiles.id anchor before any event_checkins/event_attendance/child_custody_visits row is written.
rules.enforcement_layer: Domain service (App\Domain\Events\CheckinService::scanAttempt + App\Domain\WaveFour\ChildParticipationSafetyGate::admit), backend-only, independent of any future controller/job/command caller
rules.reason: Closes W4R-01 (HIGH, P0.3.4-R). Direct calls to the generic service for a child_profiles person now throw CHILD_SAFETY_FLOW_REQUIRED before any write; the original bypass scenario (revoked consent, actor without CHILDREN) is preserved as an adversarial test and now denies with zero durable writes.

rules.rule: discipleship_enrollments has no owner_unit column in the approved catalogue; EvangelismService::progress() must resolve the enrollment's true owning unit from its creation provenance (audit_logs OUTREACH_RECORD_CREATED) via DiscipleshipEnrollmentScope, and authorize the actor against that resolved unit, never against the caller-supplied unit_id.
rules.reason: Closes W4R-02 (MEDIUM, P0.3.4-R). An actor scoped only to a different unit is denied ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED even when the Person is also a legitimate contact in that actor's unit and even when the caller passes the true owning unit_id as a parameter; same-unit progress is unaffected.

rules.rule: The decisive server clock for a temporal authorization/consent decision must be sampled (DomainClock::now, DB UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) only after the child_profiles.id anchor lock is acquired and immediately before the write, never captured earlier and reused after a lock wait.
rules.reason: Closes W4R-03 (MEDIUM, P0.3.4-R). A deterministic real-process/real-lock test holds the child anchor across the authorization's expiry window; the waiting checkout is denied PICKUP_NOT_AUTHORIZED because its decisive clock is sampled only after the anchor is finally acquired. A microsecond-boundary test confirms DATETIME(6) precision is not truncated.

rules.rule: EvangelismService::run() authorizes the actor's session/grant with a clock (EvangelismService::now(), a PHP-process clock, not DomainClock) sampled before any lock wait performed by the wrapped operation, and never re-validates after the wait. Affects campaign/contact/followup/decision/track/step/enroll/integrate/history; progress() was already fixed correctly by W4M1-03 with a post-lock, null-now decisive re-check.
rules.reason: Discovered and confirmed independently during the P0.3.4-M1-R re-audit via a real-process/real-lock test: a session whose expires_at passes purely from wall-clock time elapsing during an unrelated row-lock wait (no competing writer needed) still completed the write. Fixed in P0.3.4-M1.1: EvangelismService::now() now delegates to DomainClock; run() performs a decisive re-authorize (now=null) immediately after $work() returns, covering every lock the wrapped operation took; track()/step()'s own additional DISCIPLESHIP_CONFIGURE check was made decisive too (and moved after the track lock in step()); progress() gained a second decisive re-check after its step lock and participation check. The exact reproduction scenario (session expires during a real lock wait) now denies with zero writes for both a run()-backed writer (contact()) and a track/step-backed writer (step()); an already-expired session is denied immediately, with zero writes, for all nine writers.

rules.rule: WaveThreeCheckinConcurrencyTest::test_same_person_different_sessions_do_not_share_a_checkin_lock synchronized by polling proc_get_status()->running against a fixed 5-second wall-clock deadline for a real PHP subprocess (spawn + autoload + DB connect + full generic check-in validation) to complete, instead of a deterministic state signal.
rules.enforcement_layer: Test harness only (apps/api/tests/Database/WaveThreeCheckinConcurrencyTest.php, scripts/wave3-checkin-worker.php); not a production code or security finding
rules.reason: P0.3.4-M1-R measured a 50% failure rate in full isolation (10/10 runs). Root cause traced live via information_schema.innodb_trx: the two workers' idempotency_requests rows shared the same (actor_id, operation) prefix of the composite UNIQUE KEY uq_idempotency_requests_actor_id_operation_client_key; on a near-empty table, InnoDB's insert-intention/gap locking for that shared B-tree neighbourhood could transiently queue an unrelated worker's INSERT IGNORE behind the artificially-long-held lock the test itself takes -- an InnoDB index-structural side effect, not a security/correctness race (the independent worker always eventually converges correctly) and not reproducible under any real, millisecond-lived production transaction. Fixed: (1) the shared worker script now signals completion via a deterministic barrier file (done_<worker>) instead of proc_get_status polling; (2) the independent worker uses a second actor (further isolation); (3) both idempotency claim rows are now pre-created by the test itself, with correct hashes, before the artificial lock is taken, so neither worker's INSERT IGNORE ever needs to negotiate a fresh key into a near-empty index -- each hits an existing row and gets a plain record lock. 20/20 isolated runs pass (0 failures, versus 50% before); the loaded full suite (6 tests) also passes. The 60s deadline that remains is a harness fail-safe only, never the pass criterion.
